Data.purpose: Permettre de sauvegarder, reprendre, effacer, exporter ou importer un brouillon sans rendre la persistance obligatoire.
rules: No persistent draft is created by default.
Manual save is available when the component is enabled.
Import/export is user-controlled and works without cookies.
File/audio fields require a binary-capable adapter; serializable fields must never imply that binaries were restored when they were not.

dictionnaire_donnees.note: Contrôles de brouillon composés avec la politique de persistance client.
